assertions.title: No budget set empty state
assertions.reason: On 2030-07 the dashboard showed explicit 'No budget set' empty state with Set Budget CTA, rather than misleading budget usage values.

steps.action: Navigate dashboard month selector to July 2030
Inspect budget panel in month with no budget
steps.observed: Budget panel showed 'No budget set' and empty-state copy with Set Budget button.

assertions.title: Set a monthly budget
assertions.reason: For 2030-08, saving a new budget persisted and displayed the amount on dashboard.

steps.action: Open Set Budget modal, enter 1200, and save
steps.expected: Budget is created and shown on dashboard
steps.observed: Dashboard updated to Budget $1,200.00, Remaining $1,200.00, Usage 0.0%.

evidence.network: POST /api/budgets -> 201 and follow-up GET /api/dashboard?year=2030&month=8 -> 200 (see budget-dashboard/budget-core-ui/network-performance-budgets.json; endpoint is implemented as POST for budget save)

assertions.title: Update an existing monthly budget
assertions.reason: Existing 2030-08 budget was edited from 1500 to 1700 and displayed updated value without duplicate behavior.

steps.expected: Budget updates in-place and remains single logical month budget
steps.observed: Dashboard showed Budget $1,700.00 and Remaining $1,700.00; no duplicate budget display appeared.

evidence.network: POST /api/budgets -> 200 then GET /api/dashboard?year=2030&month=8 -> 200 (see budget-dashboard/budget-core-ui/network-performance-budgets.json; update uses POST in current implementation)

assertions.title: Dashboard with zero transactions shows $0 spent
assertions.reason: With budget set for 2030-06 and no transactions in that month, dashboard showed zero spent, full remaining budget, and zero usage.

steps.action: Navigate to June 2030 and set budget to 900
Verify calculated fields with no transactions

assertions.title: Month selector works correctly
assertions.reason: Switching months among 2030-08, 2030-07, and 2030-06 consistently refreshed dashboard values to the selected month context.

steps.observed: Budgeted month showed Budget $1,500.00/$1,700.00 in August snapshots.

steps.expected: Dashboard values update to July context
Dashboard values update to June context
steps.observed: June displayed Budget $900.00 with Spent $0.00 and Usage 0.0%.

steps.expected: Dashboard values revert to August context

evidence.network: GET /api/dashboard calls for month transitions (2030-08 -> 2030-07 -> 2030-06 -> 2030-08), all 200 (see budget-dashboard/budget-core-ui/network-performance-budgets.json)

frictions.description: Month picker is previous/next only; reaching 2030 test months from default 2026 month required many repeated clicks.
frictions.resolution: Used repeated month-navigation clicks in the same browser session and captured evidence at each target month.

summary: Tested 5 assertions (VAL-BUD-001, VAL-BUD-002, VAL-BUD-006, VAL-BUD-007, VAL-BUD-008): all passed on the real UI surface for User A with evidence captured under missionDir/evidence/budget-dashboard/budget-core-ui/.
